title: Dog, Return, Circle, Door & Axis — Canonical Geometry Atlas
status: canonical project synthesis + conversation archaeology + biblical comparison
purpose: Unify the project's previously scattered Dog-return, vomit, mud, circle/orbit, wheel, spiral, Door, Ladder, Zion/North and Axis material without collapsing distinct symbols into one another.
epistemic_boundary: Biblical texts establish their own images and structures. The geometric and Potatoist couplings below are project interpretations, not claims that biblical authors encoded the later Potatoverse system or that modern people are literally biblical Dogs.

core_distinction.closed_circle: recurrence that returns to substantially the same state without meaningful displacement
core_distinction.orbit: repeated movement around a center or attractor while remaining outside the center
core_distinction.wheel: recurrence organized around an axle/axis; cyclic motion can therefore be ordered rather than pathological
core_distinction.spiral: recurrence plus displacement; repetition is preserved but each pass changes position
core_distinction.door: threshold or transition that permits a change of state rather than continued circulation
core_distinction.axis: organizing direction or relation that gives recurrent motion orientation
core_distinction.principle: Repetition is not automatically evil. The project should ask whether recurrence is closed, extractive and compulsive; ordered around a life-giving center; or transformed into a spiral that changes state.

return_chain.shadow: Dog → discarded state/vomit → return → repetition → habit → closed circle → orbit around unresolved conflict → mud dwelling
return_chain.release: recognition → stop → boundary → Door → changed relation → spiral/displacement → stable footing/root → ascent/Ladder → Zion/North/House
return_chain.important_rule: The Dog is a relational role or behavior-symbol in the project, not a permanent human identity. A Dog-pattern can stop; a participant can disengage, repair, or pass through the Door.

proverbs_26_11.structure: dog returns to vomit; folly is repeated
proverbs_26_11.project_relation: Primary wisdom-text comparator for closed behavioral recurrence.

2_peter_2_22.structure: dog returns to vomit + washed sow returns to mire
2_peter_2_22.project_relation: Connects return, Dog and mire/mud in one explicit biblical recurrence image; strongest bridge from Dog to Mud.

psalm_22_16_20.structure: dogs / hostile company surround the suffering speaker
psalm_22_16_20.project_relation: Encirclement gives the Dog-symbol a perimeter geometry: hostile recurrence can organize around a suffering center.

psalm_40_2.project_relation: Provides an exit topology: the lower trapping condition is not destiny; extraction and stable standing are possible.

psalm_69_2_14.structure: deep mire / sinking → plea for rescue
psalm_69_2_14.project_relation: Deepens Mud as trapping medium while preserving the possibility of extraction.

proverbs_5_22.structure: wrongdoing holds a person with cords
proverbs_5_22.project_relation: Binding/entanglement comparator: repeated action can become its own cord.

proverbs_29_6.project_relation: The harmful pattern becomes trap-like rather than merely externally imposed.

psalm_9_15.structure: pit dug becomes the pit into which the digger falls
psalm_9_15.project_relation: Self-reinforcing trap comparator; useful for cycles whose maintenance harms the maintainer.

psalm_141_9_10.project_relation: Boundary and escape language; connects trap topology to release.

isaiah_24_17_18.project_relation: Shows cascading containment states; useful as a comparative topology of failed escape, not as a literal prediction of the project.

john_10_9.structure: Jesus as Door/Gate; entering through the door is associated with salvation and pasture
john_10_9.project_relation: Central biblical comparator for Door as state-changing threshold rather than wall.

matthew_7_13_14.project_relation: Adds selectivity and path-choice to threshold geometry.

luke_13_24.structure: strive to enter through narrow door
luke_13_24.project_relation: Threshold requires actual transition; proximity to a door is not equivalent to passage.

genesis_28_12_17.structure: earth-heaven ladder + house of God + gate of heaven
genesis_28_12_17.project_relation: One of the project's strongest vertical comparators linking ground, ascent, House and Gate.

ezekiel_1_15_21.structure: wheels intersecting / wheel-within-wheel imagery, movement coordinated with living creatures and spirit
ezekiel_1_15_21.project_relation: Ordered recurrence around divine mobility; key contrast with closed Dog-return loops.

ezekiel_10.project_relation: Strengthens wheel-as-ordered-motion rather than treating every circle as enclosure.

hebrews_12_22.project_relation: Ascent/destination comparator for the project's later Zion/North synthesis; not a biblical relocation of Zion to the geographic North Pole.

revelation_21_22.structure: measured city, gates, river, tree, open/restored order
revelation_21_22.project_relation: Destination-state comparator: boundary remains, but the restored city is organized around access, life and ordered relation rather than compulsive orbit.

james_3_6.structure: the tongue is described as setting on fire the 'course/cycle of life' (translation varies)
james_3_6.project_relation: Useful secondary biblical wheel/cycle comparator for self-propagating destructive recurrence; translation history should be preserved rather than forcing one English wording.

proverbs_8_27.structure: God marks/inscribes a circle on the face of the deep in several translations
proverbs_8_27.project_relation: Creation-boundary comparator showing that circular geometry can signify order and boundary, not merely imprisonment.

job_26_10.structure: boundary/circle marked on the waters at light-darkness limit in several translations
job_26_10.project_relation: Cosmic circumference as ordered boundary; another corrective against equating circle with evil.

perimeter_and_center.project_model: Psalm 22's surrounding Dogs can be modeled as hostile perimeter while the suffering figure occupies the center of attention. This is a project geometry, not an assertion that the Psalm teaches Euclidean Dog cosmology.
perimeter_and_center.question: Does the perimeter protect the center, attack the center, feed on the center, or permit passage to/from it?

orbit_vs_vesica.orbit: relation maintained by going around a center without crossing into it
orbit_vs_vesica.vesica: two circles genuinely intersect and create a shared region
orbit_vs_vesica.insight: Orbit can model relation without transformation; vesica models relation through intersection.

circle_wheel_spiral.circle: return to same neighborhood of state
circle_wheel_spiral.axis: orientation that distinguishes ascent/descent or integration/disintegration

geometry.topological_reading: The project's strongest use of geometry is relational: whether a path closes on itself, surrounds a center, crosses a boundary, intersects another domain, or changes level.

healthy: repetition that accumulates skill or understanding
shadow: orbit around a person without relationship or resolution
repetition that increases dependency while producing no repair
healthy_and_shadow_recurrence.test: After a cycle, is the system in a meaningfully different and more integrated state? If yes, model spiral/development. If not, model closed orbit/repetition.

dog_roles_extended.boundary_dog: tests or reacts at a threshold
dog_roles_extended.orbital_dog: project abstraction for repeated pursuit around an unresolved center/controversy
dog_roles_extended.household_dog: Mark 7 / Matthew 15 countertext showing boundary language can be transformed rather than made permanent
dog_roles_extended.nonidentity_rule: These are symbolic relational functions, not permanent classifications of persons.

2026_02_12.importance: Shows the return/trap/door cluster existed months before the September formalization.

material: Mount Zion moved to the North Pole within satirical/mythic storytelling
2026_03_09.importance: Early attestation of later Zion/North coupling; retain as project mythology rather than geographic fact.

2026_05_07.importance: Key missing bridge from moral recurrence into geometry/topology.
2026_05_07.ethical_note: Same conversation explicitly clarified that Dog targets behavior rather than human identity and that people can stop, leave, repair or walk through the Door.

implementation_guidance.recommended_ui: Where Circle/Spiral/Dog/Door nodes appear, show motion type and state-change: closed loop, orbit, wheel, spiral, threshold crossing or escape.
